triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

**First touch: p1 kept · `domain:devx` → `domain:ui` · `pm:queue`.** Grading principle of 2026-11-18, item 1 (the main flow and looks a user meets first), and epic #34571's phone scope.

**What is red.** All 8 failures are in `ui/e2e/live/phone-nav-drawer-back-29131.spec.ts`, 4 cases at each of 375 px and 390 px. Each fails at the same first step, `openList` (line 29): after `page.goto(LIST)` the phone app bar shows no `button[data-sidebar="trigger"]` within 5 s, so the nav drawer cannot be opened. The other 20 Console live specs pass.

**Window.** Nightly Tiers was green at `d57d6eed` (2026-11-17T05:29Z) and is red at `958ee035`, the 18.6.0 version commit. The regression is therefore in the 18.6.0 release. Candidates to read first are the app-shell commits in that window that touch the phone bar or the shell, for example #35073 (phone bar leading action) and #35071 (Home on a phone). This is a reading list, not a verdict.

**First step.** Decide whether a phone user on a list page really has no nav trigger (a product regression, possibly worth an 18.6.1 patch) or whether the spec's `LIST` or its selector drifted. Reproduce with `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase test` and open the failure screenshot in the run log. ⛔ Never skip or rename the spec to go green.

## Reading: spec drift, not a product regression (static, origin/main 958ee035)

- `AppHeader.tsx`, the app bar's left slot: `isApp && phone` renders `app-bar-phone-home` (Back to home), and the code comment says "On a phone that slot goes back to the environment's home, and the drawer opens from the bottom menu bar's 「More」 (objectstack#34594)". So `button[data-sidebar="trigger"]` is absent on a phone inside an app BY DESIGN; `openList` waits for it and fails at its first step on every leg.
- The bar is drawn on the spec's `LIST` (`/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task`): `ConsoleLayout.tsx` sets `phoneNavBar = phone && !hidesPhoneNavBar(pathname)`, and `hidesPhoneNavBar` hides it only on record pages and new/edit form pages.
- The guarded behaviour still applies when the drawer is opened from 「更多」: `UnifiedSidebar.tsx` passes `onOpenMenu={() => setOpenMobile(true)}`, and `usePhoneNavDrawerHistory` (mounted in `ConsoleLayoutInner`) keys off the same `openMobile` from `useSidebar()`, whichever control opened it.
- So the fix is to re-point the spec's opener at the 「更多」 cell (`[data-testid="phone-app-nav-more"]`), keeping every assertion. The dev runs the spec live at 375 and 390 px and reports the 8 legs.

Observation for the seat (not this card): on a phone RECORD page the bottom bar is hidden and the app bar shows the home link, so the nav drawer has no opener there. That matches #34594's design as far as the code reads, but nothing pins it on purpose.

PR #35148 merged as `348340734a935b304af47824cb20ece502869757` re-points the four phone cases at 「更多」 with every assertion unchanged (live: 8/8 red before, 9/9 after, whole nightly list 28/28). The next Nightly Tiers run is the confirmation; if it is still red this card reopens by its marker. `pm:dispatched` comes off with this comment.
